title: Bogosi jo bokhutlo jwa mmusi bo neng bo sa bonwe mo go jone
intro: Hisitori e itse babusi ba mefuta yotlhe, mme ke ba sekae fela ba ba neng ba laola puso e e tshwanang le eno. Moo phefo ka boyone e neng e arabela taelo ya bone le badiri ba go neng go sena leitlho lepe le le swang le le neng le ka bona ba dira ka natla mo tidimalong, puso eno e ne e sa tshwane le epe pele kgotsa morago ga yone. Lefa go ntse jalo le eleng bogosi jo bogolo thata bo tshwanetse go fela—mme fa jono bo ne bo fela, boammaaruri bo ne jwa tswa mo motsweding o o ikokobeditseng thata mo go neng go se na ope yo o neng a akanya go bo belaela.
clues: Ke ne ka newa bogosi jo bogolo ke Morena wa me, jo go neng go buiwa ka jone go kgabaganya ditsebe tse di boitshepo.
Ke ne ka rua botlhale jo bogolo le taolo mo motsading yo o neng a tsamaya fa pele ga me ka boineelo.
Ke ne ka laela phefo ka boyone, mme ya tsamaya kgakala ka maikaelelo a me.
Ditshedi tse di sa bonweng ke matlho a a tlwaelegileng di ne di dira ka natla ka fa tlase ga taolo ya me, di aga dikgakgamatso tse di ka se bapisiweng le sepe.
Metswedi ya kopore e e nyerolotsweng e ne ya elela mo go nna, tshegofatso e e tlhomologileng mo gare ga tse di tlhophilweng ke Allah.

Fa ke tloga mo lefatsheng leno, mmele wa me o ne wa sala o eme kgatlhanong le thobane. Ke fela fa setshedi se sennye sa lefatshe se ne se ja ka thobane eo fa batho ba ba neng ba ntikologile ba ne ba lemoga gore ke fetile.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
